items.title: Make DONE settlement default-on with explicit opt-out
items.context: Change PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED handling so unset means enabled, while false/0/no disables. Preserve learning-only, non-gate behavior and do not block lifecycle DONE.
items.userSees: A future DONE story records a learning settlement row without needing a manual env var.

happy.desc: unset PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED records settlement by default

edge.desc: explicit false/0/no disables settlement without writing

adversarial.desc: DONE settlement still cannot create helped outcome or gate evidence

items.title: Surface settlement posture in status and docs
items.context: Update status/docs wording so operators can see that DONE settlement is default-on learning health, not promotion evidence and not historical backfill.
items.userSees: playbook_promotion_status explains settlement default posture and health rows clearly.

happy.desc: status reports settlement enabled by default when env is unset

edge.desc: status reports disabled when explicit opt-out is set

adversarial.desc: status labels settlement as non-authoritative and gateEvidence=false

items.title: Prove live data enters learning after DONE
items.context: Add/adjust smoke coverage, then use this story DONE as the first live proof that settlement health data is written automatically before any historical backfill.

happy.desc: smoke proves default-on settlement records health row

adversarial.desc: settlement failure remains non-blocking and does not mutate story evidence
